_about: Interim size card for the building parts kit (Track E), from the shore plan's size table plus US residential catalogue sizes. Track 0's shared size card replaces the plan rows when it lands; these rows are the kit's own. Metres unless noted. check_sizes.py holds every built part to its row within 5 percent.
sources: US window call sizes: first two digits feet+inches wide, last two high (3050 = 3 ft 0 in x 5 ft 0 in), rough opening 1/2 in larger; unit sizes as builder catalogues list them
IRC 2021 R311.7: stair riser at most 7 3/4 in (197 mm), tread at least 10 in (254 mm); R312: guards 36 in (914 mm) where the floor is 30 in above grade; balusters under 4 in (102 mm) apart
Garage doors: 9 x 7 ft single, 16 x 7 ft double, four sections of 21 in
K-style aluminium gutters 5 in (127 mm); downspouts 2 x 3 in (51 x 76 mm)
Residential split-system condensers 2 to 4 ton: about 0.74 to 0.89 m square, 0.70 to 0.95 m tall
Brick mould casing 2 in x 1 1/4 in (51 x 32 mm); 1x4 flat casing 3 1/2 in (89 mm); 1x6 fascia 5 1/2 in (140 mm)
